title: Hand-made arena
description: DESIGN.md §17 M1: 'Single-player, one small hand-made arena.' Hand-made, and made of data. There is no level format here beyond forms and materials placed at coordinates, because in a game with no content database that is all a place can be. Worldgen (§7) replaces this file at M2; until then it is the only authored place in the project.

player.description: Not a player type. An entity with a Body, Effectors, Locomotion and Agency — §6.1 forbids anything else, and the only thing that makes it the player is that a keyboard writes its Agency.

mass_ref.description: The carried mass at which top speed halves. This is the whole of encumbrance.

rack.description: Weapons the arena hands you. Each is a form plus one material per slot; the difference between 'iron sword' and 'obsidian sword' is one string, which is §8.1's 'there is no item database' in practice.

note.description: What the numbers mean, for the loadout panel. Prose, never a stat.

form.description: For an assembly. Mutually exclusive with `material`.

material.description: For a single lump. Mutually exclusive with `form`.
